# Location scope (owned by scope:pp_cplan_country). Picks the crop farm line to grow here: a line that stands

			limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:olive_farm has_building = building_type:olive_farmstead has_building = building_type:olive_rotations has_building = building_type:olive_model_farm } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:olive_model_farm location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 29 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:olive_rotations location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 28 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:olive_farmstead location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 27 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:olive_farm location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 26 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 29 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 28 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 27 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = olive_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:olive_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 26 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_cand }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_score value = pp_cplan_farm_score_olive }
			if = {
				limit = { var:pp_cplan_score > var:pp_cplan_best }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = var:pp_cplan_score }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = var:pp_cplan_cand }
			}
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_cand
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_score
		}
	}
	# cattle (livestock)
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { pp_cplan_mode_livestock < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_building = building_type:cattle_farm has_building = building_type:cattle_farmstead has_building = building_type:cattle_rotations has_building = building_type:cattle_model_farm } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:cattle_model_farm location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 33 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:cattle_rotations location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 32 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:cattle_farmstead location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 31 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building = building_type:cattle_farm location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 30 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 33 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 32 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 31 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cattle_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cattle_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_cand value = 30 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_cand }
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_score value = pp_cplan_farm_score_cattle }
			if = {
				limit = { var:pp_cplan_score > var:pp_cplan_best }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_best value = var:pp_cplan_score }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_pick value = var:pp_cplan_cand }
			}
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_cand
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_score
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 1.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 2.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = wheat_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 2.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 3.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = wheat_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 3.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 4.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = wheat_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 4.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 5.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = wheat_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 5.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 6.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = rice_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 6.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 7.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = rice_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 7.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 8.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = rice_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 8.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 9.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = rice_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 9.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 10.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = millet_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 10.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 11.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = millet_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 11.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 12.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = millet_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 12.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 13.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = millet_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 13.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 14.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 14.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 15.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 15.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 16.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 16.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 17.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 17.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 18.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 18.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 19.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 19.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 20.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 20.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 21.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 21.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 22.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 22.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 23.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 23.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 24.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 24.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 25.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 25.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 26.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 26.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 27.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 27.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 28.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 28.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 29.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 29.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 30.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 30.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 31.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 31.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 32.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 32.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 33.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_model_farm }
	}
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_best
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_pick
}

# Location scope (the province capital): a kitchen level (the province's Cookshop budget is its max level), first that can be built.
pp_cplan_try_kitchen_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = public_kitchen } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:public_kitchen building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = public_kitchen }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cookshop } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cookshop building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cookshop }
	}
}

# Location scope: the first logistics building that can be built here ([construction_plan] logistics_order).
pp_cplan_try_logistics_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = river_boatmen_yard } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_river_boatmen_yard_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:river_boatmen_yard building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = river_boatmen_yard why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = coastal_shipping_office } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_coastal_shipping_office_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:coastal_shipping_office building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = coastal_shipping_office why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = transport_office } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_transport_office_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:transport_office building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = transport_office why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = carrier_inn } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_carrier_inn_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:carrier_inn building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = carrier_inn why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_caravanserai } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_caravanserai_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:pp_caravanserai building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_caravanserai why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_oasis_caravan_station } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_oasis_caravan_station_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:pp_oasis_caravan_station building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_oasis_caravan_station why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_yam_station } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_yam_station_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:pp_yam_station building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_yam_station why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_banjara_tanda } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_banjara_tanda_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:pp_banjara_tanda building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_banjara_tanda why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_llama_caravan_post } pp_cplan_goods_here_pp_llama_caravan_post_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:pp_llama_caravan_post building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_llama_caravan_post why = 102 }
	}

# ---- Goods ----

# Location scope: a producer of camels, a standing one first.
pp_cplan_try_goods_camels = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:camel_herders location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_herders why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:camel_stud location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_stud why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_herders why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_stud why = 103 }
	}
}
# Location scope: one more level of a standing camels producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_camels = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:camel_herders = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.08 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_basic_construction_needs } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:camel_stud = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.08 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: one more level of a standing dyes producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_dyes = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dye_plantation building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = dye_plantation } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dye_plantation building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:dye_plantation = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.09 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_basic_construction_needs } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyes_guild building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = dyes_guild } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyes_guild building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:dyes_guild = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.45 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_guild_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyes_mill building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = dyes_mill } pp_cplan_goods_here_manufactory_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyes_mill building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:dyes_mill = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.15 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_manufactory_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_mill }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyes_workshop building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = dyes_workshop } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyes_workshop building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:dyes_workshop = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.15 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyesworks building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = dyesworks } pp_cplan_goods_here_manufactory_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:dyesworks building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:dyesworks = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.15 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_manufactory_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: a producer of incense, a standing one first.
pp_cplan_try_goods_incense = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:incense_grove location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = incense_grove } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:incense_grove building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = incense_grove why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:perfumery location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = perfumery } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:perfumery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = perfumery why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = incense_grove } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:incense_grove building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = incense_grove why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = perfumery } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:perfumery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = perfumery why = 103 }
	}
}

# Location scope: one more level of a standing silk producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_silk = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:ablaq_palace building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = ablaq_palace } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:ablaq_palace building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:ablaq_palace = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.41 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_guild_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:regulated_sericulture_farm building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = regulated_sericulture_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_basic_construction_needs = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:regulated_sericulture_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }

		}

			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:sericulture_farm building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }

		}
		building_type:sericulture_farm = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.08 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_basic_construction_needs } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {

			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:silk_production_guild building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }

# Location scope: a producer of maize, a standing one first.
pp_cplan_try_goods_maize = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:maize_farm location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = maize_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:maize_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = maize_farm why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:maize_farmstead location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = maize_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:maize_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

		limit = { has_building = building_type:maize_rotations location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = maize_rotations } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:maize_rotations building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = maize_rotations why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = maize_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:maize_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

	else_if = {

		pp_cplan_construct = { type = maize_rotations why = 103 }
	}
}
# Location scope: one more level of a standing maize producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.

			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }

# Location scope: one more level of a standing rice producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_rice = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_farm building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = rice_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_village_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:rice_farm = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.07 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_village_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_farmstead building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = rice_farmstead } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_farmstead building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:rice_farmstead = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.07 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }

			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_model_farm building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = rice_model_farm } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_model_farm building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:rice_model_farm = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.07 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:rice_rotations building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }

# Location scope: one more level of a standing books producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_books = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:printing_manufactory building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = printing_manufactory } pp_cplan_goods_here_manufactory_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:printing_manufactory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:printing_manufactory = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.16 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_manufactory_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:printing_mill building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = printing_mill } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:printing_mill building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:printing_mill = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.16 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_mill_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_mill }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:printing_press_shop building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = printing_press_shop } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:printing_press_shop building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:printing_press_shop = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.16 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:scriptorium building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = scriptorium } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:scriptorium building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:scriptorium = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.47 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_guild_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }

		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannon_maker why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:cannon_workshop location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_workshop } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_workshop building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannon_workshop why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:cannons_factory location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannons_factory } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannons_factory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannons_factory why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_foundry } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_foundry building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannon_foundry why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_maker } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_maker building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannon_maker why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_workshop } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_workshop building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannon_workshop why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannons_factory } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannons_factory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cannons_factory why = 103 }
	}
}
# Location scope: one more level of a standing cannons producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_cannons = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_foundry building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_foundry } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_foundry building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:cannon_foundry = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.19 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_mill_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_maker building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_maker } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_maker building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:cannon_maker = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.56 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_guild_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_workshop building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannon_workshop } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannon_workshop building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:cannon_workshop = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.19 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_workshop_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannons_factory building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cannons_factory } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:cannons_factory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:cannons_factory = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.19 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_mill_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_mill }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: a producer of firearms, a standing one first.
pp_cplan_try_goods_firearms = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:firearms_factory location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = firearms_factory } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:firearms_factory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = firearms_factory why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:firearms_manufactory location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = firearms_manufactory } pp_cplan_goods_here_manufactory_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:firearms_manufactory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

# Location scope: one more level of a standing naval_supplies producer whose next level pays back within the
# owner's payback line.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_naval_supplies = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:naval_supplies_guild building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = naval_supplies_guild } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:naval_supplies_guild building_levels_under_construction > 0 } }
		}
		building_type:naval_supplies_guild = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_btype }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.59 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_guild_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_std }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_est_payback_years <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_payback_line }
			pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 103 }
		}
	}
	if = {

			scope:pp_cplan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_hit } }

			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:naval_supplies_mill building_level > 0 is_at_max_level = no }

		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.2 } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_pf value = pp_cplan_cd_mill_construction } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ef value = pp_cplan_eff_mill }

# Location scope: a producer of leather, a standing one first.
pp_cplan_try_goods_leather = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:managed_forest_village location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = managed_forest_village } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:managed_forest_village building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = managed_forest_village why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:tannery location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tannery } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tannery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

		limit = { has_building = building_type:tannery_mill location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tannery_mill } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tannery_mill building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = managed_forest_village } pp_cplan_goods_here_workshop_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:managed_forest_village building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = managed_forest_village why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tannery } pp_cplan_goods_here_guild_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tannery building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = tannery why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tannery_manufactory } pp_cplan_goods_here_manufactory_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tannery_manufactory building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = tannery_manufactory why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tannery_mill } pp_cplan_goods_here_mill_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:tannery_mill building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

	else_if = {

		pp_cplan_construct = { type = tanning_workshop why = 103 }
	}

		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = coal_mine_revolutions } pp_cplan_goods_here_manufactory_construction = yes NOT = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:coal_mine_revolutions building_levels_under_construction > 0 } } }

	else_if = {

	}
}

# Country scope (scope:pp_cplan_country): one construction per good and month at most, while the budget lasts.
pp_cplan_goods_run = {
	# camels
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_camels > 0.5 pp_cplan_mode_camels < 1.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_months_camels < scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_keep_months }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_camels
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_try_goods_camels = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_camels > 1.5 pp_cplan_mode_camels < 2.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_has_producer_camels = yes }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_camels
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_expand_goods_camels = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# elephants
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_elephants > 0.5 pp_cplan_mode_elephants < 1.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_months_elephants < scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_keep_months }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_elephants
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_try_goods_elephants = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_elephants > 1.5 pp_cplan_mode_elephants < 2.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_has_producer_elephants = yes }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_elephants
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_expand_goods_elephants = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# horses
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_horses > 0.5 pp_cplan_mode_horses < 1.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }

			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_try_goods_horses = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_horses > 1.5 pp_cplan_mode_horses < 2.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit

				pp_cplan_expand_goods_horses = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# livestock
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_livestock > 0.5 pp_cplan_mode_livestock < 1.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit

		}

	else_if = {

			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_has_producer_stone = yes }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_stone
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_expand_goods_stone = yes
			}
		}
	}
	# coal
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_coal > 0.5 pp_cplan_mode_coal < 1.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_months_coal < scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_keep_months }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_coal
			max = 30

			if = {

		}
	}
	else_if = {

# Country scope: sets the mode of the good named by the flag scope:pp_good to the flag scope:pp_mode
# (off / keep / expand / never). Called by the scripted GUI pp_cplan_good_mode.
pp_cplan_set_good_mode = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_good
		flag:camels = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_camels } }
		flag:elephants = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_elephants } }
		flag:horses = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_horses } }
		flag:livestock = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_livestock } }
		flag:wool = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_wool } }
		flag:beeswax = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_beeswax } }
		flag:dyes = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_dyes } }
		flag:incense = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_incense } }
		flag:tobacco = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_tobacco } }
		flag:cotton = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_cotton } }

# Location scope, scope:pp_cplan_btype set: the build cost data of that building type (increase per level,
# the price factor of its construction goods here, its efficiency term here) as temporary values for
# pp_cplan_est_cost / pp_cplan_est_payback_years.
pp_cplan_btype_data = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:bund scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_drainage scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_management scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_management_convertible scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:field_management_improved scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:incamisana scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:irrigated_fields scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:irrigation_systems scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:jiangnan_canal_network scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:jiangnan_hill_terraces scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:khmer_baray scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:land_clearance scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:paddy_water_control scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:polders scope:pp_cplan_btype = building_type:qanats } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_ipl value = 0.05 }

# Location scope: one change to rule scope:pp_rule (flag r1..rN) of this location (scripted GUI pp_cplan_rule_edit).
pp_cplan_rule_edit_switch = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_rule
		flag:r1 = { pp_cplan_rule_edit = { n = 1 } }
		flag:r2 = { pp_cplan_rule_edit = { n = 2 } }
		flag:r3 = { pp_cplan_rule_edit = { n = 3 } }
		flag:r4 = { pp_cplan_rule_edit = { n = 4 } }
	}
}

# ---- Location templates (scripted GUI pp_cplan_template): a location's mode and rules saved on the country ----
# Location scope; scope:pp_slot = flag t1..tN, scope:pp_key = flag save / apply / province.
pp_cplan_template_do = {
	save_scope_as = pp_cplan_loc
	owner = { save_scope_as = pp_cplan_country }
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_slot
		flag:t1 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_template_save_1 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:province }
				province ?= {
					every_location_in_province = {
						limit = { owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
						save_scope_as = pp_cplan_loc
						pp_cplan_template_apply_1 = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_template_apply_1 = yes
			}
		}
		flag:t2 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_template_save_2 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:province }
				province ?= {
					every_location_in_province = {
						limit = { owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
						save_scope_as = pp_cplan_loc
						pp_cplan_template_apply_2 = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_template_apply_2 = yes
			}
		}
		flag:t3 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_template_save_3 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:province }
				province ?= {
					every_location_in_province = {
						limit = { owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
						save_scope_as = pp_cplan_loc
						pp_cplan_template_apply_3 = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_template_apply_3 = yes
			}
		}
		flag:t4 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_template_save_4 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:province }
				province ?= {
					every_location_in_province = {
						limit = { owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
						save_scope_as = pp_cplan_loc
						pp_cplan_template_apply_4 = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_template_apply_4 = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Province scope: apply template scope:pp_slot (flag t1..tN) to every location of the province its owner owns
# (scripted GUI pp_cplan_template_province).
pp_cplan_template_province_do = {
	owner ?= {
		save_scope_as = pp_cplan_country
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:pp_cplan_country }
		every_location_in_province = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:pp_cplan_country }
			save_scope_as = pp_cplan_loc
			switch = {
				trigger = scope:pp_slot
				flag:t1 = { pp_cplan_template_apply_1 = yes }
				flag:t2 = { pp_cplan_template_apply_2 = yes }
				flag:t3 = { pp_cplan_template_apply_3 = yes }
				flag:t4 = { pp_cplan_template_apply_4 = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope (scope:pp_cplan_loc = this location, scope:pp_cplan_country = its owner): template 1.
pp_cplan_template_save_1 = {
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_t1_saved value = 101 } }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_mode to = pp_cplan_t1_mode }
	pp_cplan_put_scope = { from = pp_cplan_r1_b to = pp_cplan_t1_r1_b }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r1_lv to = pp_cplan_t1_r1_lv }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r1_m to = pp_cplan_t1_r1_m }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r1_c to = pp_cplan_t1_r1_c }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r1_t to = pp_cplan_t1_r1_t }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r1_pb to = pp_cplan_t1_r1_pb }
	pp_cplan_put_scope = { from = pp_cplan_r2_b to = pp_cplan_t1_r2_b }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r2_lv to = pp_cplan_t1_r2_lv }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r2_m to = pp_cplan_t1_r2_m }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r2_c to = pp_cplan_t1_r2_c }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r2_t to = pp_cplan_t1_r2_t }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r2_pb to = pp_cplan_t1_r2_pb }
	pp_cplan_put_scope = { from = pp_cplan_r3_b to = pp_cplan_t1_r3_b }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r3_lv to = pp_cplan_t1_r3_lv }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r3_m to = pp_cplan_t1_r3_m }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r3_c to = pp_cplan_t1_r3_c }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r3_t to = pp_cplan_t1_r3_t }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r3_pb to = pp_cplan_t1_r3_pb }
	pp_cplan_put_scope = { from = pp_cplan_r4_b to = pp_cplan_t1_r4_b }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r4_lv to = pp_cplan_t1_r4_lv }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r4_m to = pp_cplan_t1_r4_m }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r4_c to = pp_cplan_t1_r4_c }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r4_t to = pp_cplan_t1_r4_t }
	pp_cplan_put_num = { from = pp_cplan_r4_pb to = pp_cplan_t1_r4_pb }
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tpl value = 101 }
}
pp_cplan_template_apply_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_t1_saved } }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_mode to = pp_cplan_mode }
		pp_cplan_take_scope = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r1_b to = pp_cplan_r1_b }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r1_lv to = pp_cplan_r1_lv }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r1_m to = pp_cplan_r1_m }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r1_c to = pp_cplan_r1_c }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r1_t to = pp_cplan_r1_t }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r1_pb to = pp_cplan_r1_pb }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r1_st
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r1_est
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r1_has
		pp_cplan_take_scope = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r2_b to = pp_cplan_r2_b }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r2_lv to = pp_cplan_r2_lv }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r2_m to = pp_cplan_r2_m }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r2_c to = pp_cplan_r2_c }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r2_t to = pp_cplan_r2_t }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r2_pb to = pp_cplan_r2_pb }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r2_st
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r2_est
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r2_has
		pp_cplan_take_scope = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r3_b to = pp_cplan_r3_b }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r3_lv to = pp_cplan_r3_lv }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r3_m to = pp_cplan_r3_m }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r3_c to = pp_cplan_r3_c }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r3_t to = pp_cplan_r3_t }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r3_pb to = pp_cplan_r3_pb }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r3_st
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r3_est
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r3_has
		pp_cplan_take_scope = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r4_b to = pp_cplan_r4_b }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r4_lv to = pp_cplan_r4_lv }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r4_m to = pp_cplan_r4_m }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r4_c to = pp_cplan_r4_c }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r4_t to = pp_cplan_r4_t }
		pp_cplan_take_num = { from = pp_cplan_t1_r4_pb to = pp_cplan_r4_pb }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r4_st
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r4_est
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_r4_has
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tpl value = 101 }
		pp_cplan_own_sync = yes
	}
}

# Location scope (scope:pp_cplan_loc = this location, scope:pp_cplan_country = its owner): template 2.
pp_cplan_template_save_2 = {

# ---- Global profiles (scripted GUI pp_cplan_profile): the country settings, rule groups and goods modes ----
# Country scope; scope:pp_slot = flag p1..pN, scope:pp_key = flag save / load.
pp_cplan_profile_do = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_slot
		flag:p1 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_profile_save_1 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_p1_saved }
				pp_cplan_profile_load_1 = yes
			}
		}
		flag:p2 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_profile_save_2 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_p2_saved }
				pp_cplan_profile_load_2 = yes
			}
		}
		flag:p3 = {
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_key = flag:save }
				pp_cplan_profile_save_3 = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_p3_saved }
				pp_cplan_profile_load_3 = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: profile 1.
